description: Move an existing service on a fixed plan (Tor Hosting, hosting, a fixed VPS plan, dedicated) to another plan — the answer to "my site is slow, I need more resources". The new plan must be one of the upgrades its current plan offers; any other is refused with the list of those (product_id and billing cycles), and nothing is charged. The configurable VPS is not moved between plans: give it more CPU, memory or disk with impreza_vps_resize. The price is what the billing system pro-rates to the next due date, paid from the account credit balance, which must already cover it (top up first with impreza_topup) — nothing is ordered when it does not. Requires the "manage" scope. Returns order_id, invoice_id, amount and status. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.

billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle for the new plan, e.g. monthly, annually.

new_product_id.description: Target plan id: one of the upgrades the current plan offers (a refusal lists them).

service_id.description: The service to upgrade (from impreza_list_services or impreza_list_dedicated).

name: impreza_upgrade_service
title: Upgrade service plan
